'''Juranno''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], situated in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] valley. The city had been deliberately built in this spot, so it looked like it had been carved from the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] surrounding it. During the [[Great Galactic War]], Juranno was also the location of [[House Panteer]]'s [[Summer/Legends|Summer]] [[Palace]].

==History==
In [[3667 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] launched a surprise [[Battle of Alderaan|attack]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and invaded the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|world]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces, led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]], [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] Alderaan, [[Death/Legends|killing]] innumerable people and burning entire [[City/Legends|cities]], including Juranno.<ref name="Trailer" />

==Behind the scenes==
The city of Juranno first appeared in [[Hope (cinematic trailer)|''Hope'']], the second cinematic trailer for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Trailer" /> Its name was later revealed in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', released on [[October 15]], [[2012]].<ref name="SWTORE" />
